name: backlog
description: Monitors and maintains backlog health. Surfaces stale issues and blocked work so the queue stays actionable.

issues.title: Create roadmap and generate initial backlog
issues.description: Review the company goal, create a ROADMAP.md with milestones, then prepare acceptance-ready issues sized to company delivery capacity. If docs/lean-delivery.md exists, prepare only the next 3-5 and apply its WIP limits; otherwise no lean cap is implied. Assign only work that fits owner and review capacity; keep later roadmap items prioritized but inactive. Scope each issue to one deliverable, link it to the relevant goal/project, and give every implementation issue (including subissues) an isolated workspace unless explicit same-change reuse is required.

routines.title: Backlog grooming
routines.description: Routine-run checklist: inspect roadmap plus implementation/review capacity under company policy. If docs/lean-delivery.md exists, apply its WIP limits and create at most the next 1-3 scoped issues only when capacity is free; otherwise size the batch to company capacity. Assign only work with an available owner and review path, link artifacts/goals/projects, summarize evidence and changes on the routine issue, then exit.
